title: Ryot 35cm Axe Pack W/ SmellSafe Technology
description:
Ryot 14” Axe Pack with SmellSafe Technology & Ryot Lock
The new and improved hard case Axe Pack by Ryot is your premier option for storing and transporting large glass pieces and any other goodies that can fit into this fully padded case.
The Axe Pack comes standard with lockable zip pulls, Ryot 3 digit code lock, padded insert divider with built-in silicone mate, X-strap system for all your smaller items, small removable pouch and shoulder strap.
SmellSafe Technology
The padded divider in the Axe Pack has one more function. And that is odor control.
The SmellSafe Carbon Series incorporates extensive carbon fiber padding that both neutralizes and traps odors in its pores while their coated weather-proof fabric and moisture seal zipper provide a true physical barrier to keep odors in and the weather out. To re-activate the carbon lining filters, simply put in the dryer for 5 minutes.
Dimensions
Interior
length – 34cm
width – 14cm
height – 10cm
Included
1 x Axe Pack W/ SmellSafe Technology
1 x Ryot Lock
﻿
